name: MCP Server (stdio)
description: Expose the project's application use-cases as MCP tools over stdio — an inbound adapter with a static tool registry, a transport-factory seam, and a dynamic SDK import (ADR-0010).

questions.prompt: MCP server name advertised to clients?

checklist: Install the SDK (there is no manifest deps field — this is the only channel): npm install @modelcontextprotocol/sdk
Set MCP_SERVER_NAME in .env (defaults to the project name).
Add a tool: copy src/infrastructure/mcp/tools/example.tool.ts, wrap your use-case, then add one import + registerTool(...) line in registry/register-all.ts.
Point your MCP client at the server using .mcp.json.example — it runs: npx tsx bin/cli.ts (.ts isn't executable by node directly; use tsx, or build and run node dist/bin/cli.js).
Verify with the inspector: npx @modelcontextprotocol/inspector npx tsx bin/cli.ts
For remote/HTTP access, install the mcp-server-http addon (always authenticated).
